quarterly_data.quarter: Hengtong Optic-Electric half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: the AI advanced optical fiber materials R&D and manufacturing center expansion (200 mu site; phase 1 for high-performance multiband multimode, ultra-low-loss hollow-core and ultra-low-loss multi-core specialty fiber) finished its phase-1 plant in February 2026 and is now completed and in production.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hengtong Optic-Electric half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: Hengtong's MPO series (high-density MPO cables and MPO cable assemblies for data centers) has been selected by leading domestic internet companies and is in stable supply, building AI data-center cabling solutions with these customers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hengtong Optic-Electric half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: hollow-core fiber lowest attenuation reached 0.04dB/km; in May 2026 Hengtong won China Telecom's 2026 western information-center hub interconnect hollow-core hybrid cable procurement, so its hollow-core wins now cover all three domestic operators; in June 2026 it and Zhejiang Unicom completed China's first 400G provincial trunk hollow-core fiber line, now in trial commercial use.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hengtong Optic-Electric half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: in June 2026 its self-developed CPO polarization-maintaining fiber achieved a core-technology breakthrough; the HPPD high-precision drawing process controls bare-fiber diameter to within 0.1μm and stress-zone symmetry to within 0.2μm.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hengtong Optic-Electric half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: for computing centers Hengtong offers the full 10G-800G AOC range and high-speed optical modules, with high-speed AOCs in batch use; it released a 50G COMBO PON OLT asymmetric module; since 2025 it plans an R&D and industrialization project for 1.6T core optoelectronic conversion devices for AI and is building CPO advanced packaging capability for next-generation high-speed optical interconnect.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hengtong Optic-Electric half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: ultra-low-loss large-effective-area G.654.E fiber lowest attenuation 0.144dB/km, now commercial at million-core-km scale and used in dozens of national computing hub nodes; in April 2026 its new G.654.E fiber for provincial trunk networks completed 800G transmission validation with China Unicom Research Institute and ZTE (provincial trunk, DCI and metro scenarios).

quarterly_data.quarter: Hengtong Optic-Electric half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: cumulative signed and delivered submarine optical cable exceeds 130,000 km; ocean communication order backlog about RMB 70 hundred million at period end; won the China-Cambodia TKO STUB, Indonesia PT ION and Beihai-Lingao projects; SEA-H2X entered commercial service; the ALC system is expected to reach full commercial service at end-2026.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hengtong Optic-Electric half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: the AKSCS submarine optical cable system built by subsidiary HMN Tech finished all equipment production, acceptance tests and marine installation and is planned to reach full commercial service in Q4 2026; its 32-fiber-pair system creates a 3.7 ms direct link between Azerbaijan and Kazakhstan.
